result.instructions: Tools for BKG, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bookings does the salon have tomorrow, and who is working?"; "Find the first free 60-minute slot for a haircut with Maria next Tuesday."; "Show the client record for this phone number and their last three bookings.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes BKG data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bkg_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bkg_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bkg_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bkg_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bkg_me
tools.title: Show the salon for this key
tools.description: Show which salon the API key belongs to, its scopes and its rate limit. Use it first to confirm the connection. BKG API: GET /me.

annotations.title: Show the salon for this key

tools.name: bkg_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services the salon sells (name, duration, price, category). BKG API: GET /services.

include_inactive.description: Also list services that are switched off (default false).

tools.name: bkg_get_service
tools.title: Get a service
tools.description: Get one service by id, with its duration, price and rules. BKG API: GET /services/{service_id}.

tools.name: bkg_list_staff
tools.title: List staff
tools.description: List the staff members (employees) of the salon. BKG API: GET /staff.

tools.name: bkg_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the salon's locations (branches). BKG API: GET /locations.

tools.name: bkg_get_staff_schedule
tools.title: Get staff working hours
tools.description: Get the planned working hours per day for staff, with days off and special days applied. Range: at most 62 days. BKG API: GET /staff/schedule.

end.description: Last day, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD (at most 62 days after start).

tools.name: bkg_search_availability
tools.title: Search free times
tools.description: Find free booking times for a service on a day or a range of up to 14 days. Use it before bkg_create_booking. BKG API: GET /availability.

date_to.description: Last day, inclusive, at most 14 days after date.

staff_id.description: Only this staff member. Omit for anyone who performs the service.

tools.name: bkg_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings, filtered by time range, status, client, staff or service. BKG API: GET /bookings.

start.description: Bookings that start at or after this salon-local time, e.g. 2026-11-18T00:00:00.

end.description: Bookings that start before this salon-local time.

status.description: Booking status filter, as the salon's status names.

updated_since.description: Only records changed at or after this ISO 8601 time. Results then sort by updated_at (use for sync).

tools.name: bkg_get_booking
tools.title: Get a booking
tools.description: Get one booking by id: service, staff, location, time, status and price. BKG API: GET /bookings/{booking_id}.

tools.name: bkg_list_clients
tools.title: List or search clients
tools.description: Search clients by name, email or phone, or list them. BKG API: GET /clients.

q.description: Name, email or phone contains this text.

updated_since.description: Only records changed at or after this ISO 8601 time. Results then sort by updated_at (use for sync).

tools.name: bkg_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client by id: contact details and notes. BKG API: GET /clients/{client_id}.

tools.name: bkg_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments, optionally for one booking or status. BKG API: GET /payments.

status.description: Payment status filter, as the salon's status names.

updated_since.description: Only records changed at or after this ISO 8601 time. Results then sort by updated_at (use for sync).

tools.name: bkg_create_booking
tools.title: Create a booking
tools.description: Create a booking at a free time from bkg_search_availability. Writes to the salon's calendar. BKG API: POST /bookings.

staff_id.description: Omit for 'any available'; the service rule then assigns staff.

accept_policy.description: Set true only when the client accepted the salon's cancellation terms (see GET /policy). Needed when the service has a policy.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key (a UUID is ideal). Omit it to get a new key for this call.

tools.name: bkg_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel a booking
tools.description: Cancel one booking. The salon's cancellation terms apply. BKG API: POST /bookings/{booking_id}/cancel.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key (a UUID is ideal). Omit it to get a new key for this call.

tools.name: bkg_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client record with contact details and notes. BKG API: POST /clients.

locale.description: Language for client messages, e.g. da, en.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key (a UUID is ideal). Omit it to get a new key for this call.

prompts.name: find_an_open_time_for_a_service
